berlin-motorcycle-escapes-saxon-switzerl.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Treat High point near Michendorf → Near Grunewald as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch near Velten → Photo stop near Oranienburg is the reward section in Berlin motorcycle escapes. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.to: Near Waldsieversdorf, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Oranienburg → Near Waldsieversdorf, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.from: Near Waldsieversdorf, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Grünheide → Back to Saxon Switzerland is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.
